{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
# The data dictionary suggests -999.0 is a sentinel for missing
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Count how many times the sentinel appears
count_sentinel = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum()

# Replace sentinel values with NaN
data_clean = data.copy()
data_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = data_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(sentinel_value, pd.NA)

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value, excluding sentinel values
mean_baseline = data_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean(numeric_only=True)

# Output the result
mean_baseline"}
